kappa_biggamma.csv.description: exact plaquette loss coefficient at strong loss (definitions of fig_zeno/postprocess.py)

sigma_extrema.csv.description: local extrema (order 20, i.e. 0.2 in omega) of the exact -Im/Re Sigma^R_up on [-6, 6] (fig_sigma data), each paired with the nearest extremum of the same kind of the method

sigma_features.csv.description: shape of Sigma^R_up(omega) on omega in [-6, 6] (fig_sigma data)

columns.peak_w: omega of the largest local maximum of -Im Sigma at omega < 0 [h1]
columns.posmin_w: omega of the deepest local minimum of -Im Sigma at omega > 0 [h1]
columns.re_max_w: omega of the largest local maximum of Re Sigma [h1]
columns.re_min_w: omega of the deepest local minimum of Re Sigma [h1]

stability.csv.description: strongly damped impurity, G1-G2 to t = 600 from a slightly polarized impurity (pert: n_up 0.101, n_dn 0.100) and from the polarized start (ic10)

columns.nd_end: impurity occupation at the last frame [1]
